description: This file implements the PdfEncryptionV5 class, which handles encryption and decryption for PDF files using security handler version 5 (PDF 2.0). It includes methods for initializing encryption, handling passwords, encrypting/decrypting data, and validating passwords, specifically for PDF security version 5.

classes.name: PdfEncryptionV5
classes.description: Handles PDF encryption version 5, including password validation, encryption/decryption, and permission checks.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets encryption parameters, including version, revision, length, and encryption method.

methods.name: InitializeFromLoadedSecurityHandler
methods.description: Initializes encryption settings from saved security handler data.

methods.name: CheckValues
methods.description: Validates version, revision, and length values for encryption compatibility.

methods.name: IsVersionSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given version value is supported (version 5).

methods.name: EnterObject
methods.description: Placeholder for handling object entry for encryption; no operation needed.

methods.name: LeaveObject
methods.description: Placeholder for handling object exit from encryption; no operation needed.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Encrypts bytes for a specific PDF object using AES encryption.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Decrypts bytes for a specific PDF object using AES decryption.

methods.name: CreateAesForObjectsCryptography
methods.description: Creates an AES instance configured for object encryption/decryption.

methods.name: CreateAesForHashCryptography
methods.description: Creates an AES instance configured for hash-related cryptography.

methods.name: CreateAesForKeyCryptography
methods.description: Creates an AES instance configured for key cryptography.

methods.name: CreateAesForPermissionsCryptography
methods.description: Creates an AES instance configured for permissions encryption.

methods.name: PrepareEncryptionForSaving
methods.description: Prepares and writes encryption parameters and keys into the PDF security dictionary.

methods.name: CreateAndStoreEncryptionKey
methods.description: Generates a secure random encryption key for the PDF.

methods.name: CreateUtf8Password
methods.description: Generates a UTF-8 password with SASLprep normalization and truncation.

methods.name: ComputeUserValues
methods.description: Computes user password hash and encrypted value for PDF encryption.

methods.name: ComputeOwnerValues
methods.description: Computes owner password hash and encrypted value for PDF encryption.

methods.name: ComputeHashInternal
methods.description: Calculates a cryptographic hash for passwords, supporting multiple algorithms and revisions.

methods.name: ComputeHashRevision5Internal
methods.description: Computes hash for revision 5 using SHA-256.

methods.name: ComputePermsValue
methods.description: Generates the permissions value block, encrypts it, and returns it.

methods.name: ValidatePassword
methods.description: Validates an input password against stored encryption data, determining password type.

methods.name: RetrieveAndStoreEncryptionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the encryption key from stored owner/user values and permissions.

methods.name: GetUserOwnerHashValue
methods.description: Extracts hash part from user/owner value.

methods.name: GetUserOwnerValidationSalt
methods.description: Extracts validation salt from user/owner value.

methods.name: GetUserOwnerKeySalt
methods.description: Extracts key salt from user/owner value.

methods.name: ValidateUserPassword
methods.description: Checks if a password matches the user password hash.

methods.name: ValidateOwnerPassword
methods.description: Checks if a password matches the owner password hash.

methods.name: ValidatePermissions
methods.description: Verifies decrypted permissions match expected values.

methods.name: GetUserOwnerHashValue
methods.description: Returns the hash segment of user/owner value.

methods.name: GetUserOwnerValidationSalt
methods.description: Returns the validation salt segment of user/owner value.

methods.name: GetUserOwnerKeySalt
methods.description: Returns the key salt segment of user/owner value.
